verdict.rationale: Unreal's Python scripting docs explicitly call out automating asset management tasks (LOD generation), building asset import pipelines that tie the Editor to other 3D apps, and creating custom UIs, plus general Editor Scripting/Automation docs mention creating asset import and management pipelines and Asset Manager control over discovery/loading. This directly supports import-hook-style automation for technical artists, but the evidence lacks concrete import-hook API details (e.g., FEditorDelegates::OnAssetPostImport, factory overrides), example pipeline scripts, or independent/hands-on confirmation that this works smoothly in production. missing for 10: documented import-hook/event API specifics, real-world pipeline script examples, independent corroboration of reliability at scale.
